method: Official amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> pages opened through the page-fetch tool, read down to the chunk that prints the listing's 'Product information' block (Features & Specs / Measurements / Item details). Title read from the page <title> element. No scripted scraping, no third-party mirrors, no inference. Values the page did not print are recorded as blank and stay blank in the register.
supersedes: Adds a dated row set to data/verification.json and data/reverification-2026-11-20.json. Does not overwrite either file.
